lost_island.name: Lost Island
lost_island.description: A remote, uncharted tropical island with remnants of a forgotten civilization.

Positive: Washed up cargo from a shipwreck
A flock of easily huntable birds lands nearby
Negative: Food spoiling from the extreme jungle humidity
A swarm of aggressive hornets invading the camp
A flash flood washing away some supplies
Neutral: Eerie unsettling silence in the jungle
Mysterious giant footprints found on the beach
Spotting a plane that flies over without seeing you
Strange, glowing moss blooming on the trees
An unusually thick, blinding fog rolls in

xeno_planet.name: Xeno-73 Outpost
xeno_planet.description: A hostile, crimson-skied alien planet with bizarre flora and hostile insectoid life.

Positive: A period of optimal solar charging weather
Finding a cluster of high-grade scrap metal
Negative: An acid rain storm forcing everyone indoors
A breach in the camp perimeter by alien predators
A localized EMP destroying some gathered data
Neutral: Unidentified radio static on the comms channel
Watching a massive, silent creature migrate in the distance
Eerie, melodic humming coming from the crystal formations
